title: 焚化飛灰穩定化
summary: 本課以「分辨飛灰污染總量、固定化效能與長期浸出證據」為主軸，依序處理飛灰與防制殘渣界定、乾基添加量、固定介質容量概念、洗液與污染轉移、穩定化能耗比較。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。
summaryEn: This course focuses on Distinguish fly-ash inventory, immobilization performance and long-term leaching evidence, progressing through Fly ash and control-residue identification, Dry-basis amendment quantity, Immobilizing-media capacity, Wash water and contaminant transfer, Stabilization energy comparison. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.
